title: TaskArtifact
description: An artifact of a task: a copy of a file kept by Gentry, or a link Gentry does not visit.

name.description: Name of the artifact: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.

kind.description: Kind of the artifact: file — a copy of a file, link — an address.

path.description: Absolute path of the copy of a file.

source.description: Who saved the artifact: operator or agent.

saved.description: Time the artifact was saved in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
